_comment: Copy into the experiment folder as config.json and fill in. Everything the run depends on is recorded here so the experiment is reproducible. Delete the _comment keys.
experiment: <one-line description, e.g. ECM oracle-clear (specific) vs baseline (referential)>
output_prefix: <unique prefix; runner output goes to output/<prefix>_<condition>_s<session>>
_comment_prefix: Must be unused. Reusing a prefix makes the driver think episodes are done and skip work.
_comment_conditions: a is the clear/treatment arm, b the baseline. These strings are passed to --instruction-type and must be keys in every task's instruction dict; verify with check_variants.py.
_comment_task_dirs: Leave empty to use the repo default task dirs, or give absolute paths to run tasks that live outside the repo tree.
initial_state: deterministic reset_scene_to_default (no pose randomization); identical across episodes and conditions; matched pairs are (task, env_id)
condition_order: ABBA by block: even blocks run condition a first, odd blocks run condition b first
retry_policy: Kit startup crashes retried up to max_attempts per (block, condition) with a startup lock and a global cool-down; the runner resumes and skips completed runs; unresolved blocks are reported
success_signal: env termination `success` term as recorded by robolab.eval.summarize (truncations including undesired_behavior count as failure)
design: <why each task can show an instruction effect: the target must not be the policy's default pick; see references/task_design.md>
_comment_excluded: Tasks left out and why, e.g. missing an instruction variant.

tasks.default_pick: <object the policy grabs under the ambiguous prompt; must differ from target>
